data.name: TORNBLADE
data.detailed_description:
TORNBLADE is a dark, brutal indie action RPG inspired by the spirit of classic games from the 80s and 90s – a time when imagination filled the gaps left by pixels. 
It’s a tribute to an era when games built worlds of mystery, and every discovery carried weight. 

You play as a lone knight, a wanderer traversing a land drowned in decay and silence. 
His body is consumed by a dark affliction born from a mysterious substance. Saving yourself from corruption may also mean saving others – those still clinging to the shadows. 
Each step toward the truth brings you closer to understanding that the line between redemption and damnation is as thin as the edge of your blade. The world rots and fades, and what lurks beneath its surface waits for those who dare to uncover it. 

During your journey, you will explore the vast realm of Hraefnfeld from a top-down perspective — moving across its territories, uncovering landmarks that reveal new fragments of the map. Speak with the remaining inhabitants, investigate ruins, and discover hidden paths and treasures marked on ancient maps. Find armor, weapons, and artifacts that will help you endure the horrors roaming these forsaken lands. 

In the side-scroll view, face brutal opponents in demanding combat where reflex, precision, and composure mean survival. 
You’ll also encounter segments that test your dexterity and courage as you navigate deadly obstacles. 

 

⚔️ Dual Perspective Gameplay 

Top-down: explore the dark corners of the world, uncover secrets, and immerse yourself in its heavy, mystical atmosphere. 

Side-scroll: engage in brutal encounters against merciless foes who do not forgive weakness. 

 

🩸 Darkness, Brutality & Aesthetic 

Gore, violence, and horror are not mere decoration – they shape the atmosphere of unease and mystery. 
Every detail, every fragment of the world tells a story of ancient glory and inevitable ruin. 

 

🕯️ Exploration & Secrets 

The land of Hraefnfeld hides countless passages, secret locations, and lost artifacts. 
Every place holds meaning, and uncovering its past may change not only the world – but also yourself. 

 

⚙️ Progression & Combat 

Acquire new armor, weapons, and abilities. 
Your choice of fighting style, tactics, and reaction to what you encounter will shape your path forward. 

 

🎨 Artistic Consistency 

The game is being created by a small two-person team – one creator and one programmer – driven by a passion for dark, classic RPGs. 

The world of TORNBLADE is crafted with a focus on raw, immersive atmosphere: light, mist, decay, and destruction blend into a single haunting vision inspired by Celtic mythology. 

 

Every decision, every battle, and every discovery matters. 
Immerse yourself in the land of Hraefnfeld, where legend and darkness intertwine, and where solitude, fear, and temptation become part of your journey. 

 

🛠️ Project Status 

The game is currently in an advanced stage of production. 
All videos and screenshots have been captured in-engine, in real time. 

Add TORNBLADE to your Steam wishlist to follow the journey and not miss the release of this world.

data.short_description: TORNBLADE is a dark action game combining top-down exploration with direct side-scroll combat, inspired by the uncompromising spirit of classic games from the 80s and 90s, and shaped by Slavic and Celtic atmosphere.
data.supported_languages:
English*, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Polish
*languages with full audio support

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: ntel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT (8 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
